ぺーじんぐ [ぺーじんぐ] (common)

Readings: ぺーじんぐ
Furigana: ぺーじんぐ

Noun (common) (futsuumeishi)

  1. paging probe

Synonyms:
  覆う  [おおう]
     to cover; to hide; to conceal
  死す  [しす]
     to die

Antonyms:
  食う  [くう]
     to eat
  感ずる  [かんずる]
     to feel; to sense; to experience
  検討  [けんとう]
     consideration; examination; investigation
